link_scan_rule.include: Literal Markdown links whose parsed target ends exactly in SKILL.md
link_scan_rule.exclude: Targets with protocol prefixes; leading slash, hash or tilde; or template/dynamic markers { } $ < >. Targets are stripped of angle wrappers and double-quoted title suffixes. Anchored SKILL.md links do not end in SKILL.md and are excluded.
link_scan_rule.resolution: Resolve relative to containing skill directory; missing means filesystem target does not exist at scan time. Archive candidate inserts _archive below the canonical skill root.
link_scan_rule.counting: Occurrence count, including repeated links; restricted to nonarchive skills for summary. Regex matches may include examples, so this is a structural candidate list, not a count of executable defects.
